name: chat_deepseek
prompt:
You are given the amino-acid sequence of a single protein chain. Predict its three-dimensional structure.

Sequence ({L} residues):
{seq}

Output your predicted structure as a PDB file that contains only the C-alpha atom of every residue, in order:
exactly {L} ATOM records (atom name CA, chain A, residue numbers 1 to {L}, correct three-letter residue names,
coordinates in Angstroms with three decimals in standard PDB columns), followed by END.
Example of one record:
ATOM      1  CA  MET A   1      12.345  -4.567   6.789  1.00  0.00           C
Do not use any tools. Do not write code. Output only the PDB file, with no other text.
